description: This file declares classes and method signatures for implementing SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) expansion strategies for various gather operations in the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR backend. It defines expander classes for GatherV2, ResourceGather, and GatherNd operations, including methods for layout computation and expansion logic, but does not contain actual method implementations.

classes.name: GatherCommonSPMDExpander
classes.description: Abstract base class for common gather operation expansion logic, providing methods for expanding Ops, and computing layouts both forward and backward.

classes.name: GatherV2SPMDExpander
classes.description: Concrete expander class for the GatherV2 operation, implements methods to expand the operation and retrieve axis and batch dimension info.

classes.name: ResourceGatherSPMDExpander
classes.description: Concrete expander class for the ResourceGather operation, implements methods to expand the operation and retrieve axis and batch dimension info.

classes.name: GatherNdSPMDExpander
classes.description: Expander class for the GatherNd operation, related to layout computation and expansion.

methods.name: StatusOr<mlir::Operation * > ExpandOpHelper(mlir::Operation * op)
methods.description: Template method that performs common expansion logic for gather operations, including layout adjustments and all-gather relayouts, returning the new operation.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes and returns the input layouts given the operation; overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes and returns the output layouts given the operation; overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Retrieves the expansion-specific axis argument from the operation; pure virtual.

methods.name: GetBatchDim
methods.description: Retrieves the expansion-specific batch dimension argument from the operation; pure virtual.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Implements the main expansion logic for each specific gather operation.
